# Game model (6 levels)

## Board
- 512x512 px, drawn on a 64x64 grid of 8px cells. Cell (c,r) center = (8c+4, 8r+4).

## Elements
- **Player**: blue square block inside a gray corridor. Has a size (4x4 cells, 2x2 cells, ...).
  Half of it is dark blue (#1E93FF) and half light blue (#88D8F1); the dark half indicates facing direction.
- **Corridor**: gray (#999999) region the player travels through. Narrow sections require a smaller player.
- **Goal**: dark-blue "C" bracket at the end of the corridor with light-blue interior (level 1: cols 12-16, rows 17-22, interior 4x4 at cols 13-16 rows 18-21).
- **Click pad** (bottom, large box, 3x3 grid of 3x3-cell blocks, gray border #666666):
  white blocks = clickable targets. Clicking one turns it green. Turning ALL white blocks green
  executes an effect on the player (level 1: player shrank 4x4 -> 2x2), then the pad goes all-gray (inactive).
- **Purple box** (bottom-left, 3x3 grid of 2x2-cell blocks, purple #A356D6 marks): appears to be
  a legend/spec of the pattern (same plus-shape as the pad).
- **Right green strip** (cols 62-63, 64 rows): resource/cost bar. Fills white from the top,
  ~2 rows per effective action. Invalid actions cost nothing.

## Actions
- ACTION1/2/3/4 = up/down/left/right. Moves the player one step = its own size in cells
  (2x2 player moves 2 cells per press). Also sets facing. A press into a blocked direction is a no-op.
- ACTION6 = click. Only valid on white pad blocks; clicking elsewhere flashes the pad RED (no cost).
- No RESET/ACTION5/ACTION7 offered so far.

## Tactics
- Big player = fewer presses per distance. Shrink only right before a narrow section.

# Game model (6 levels)

## Board
- 512x512 px on a 64x64 grid of 8px cells. Cell (c,r) center = (8c+4, 8r+4).

## Elements
- **Player**: blue square block (usually 4x4 cells) inside a gray (#999999) corridor system.
  Split into a strong-blue half (#1E93FF) and pale half (#88D8F1); strong-blue half = the leading
  edge of the last move (facing). Facing defaults to UP at level start regardless of drawing.
- **Goal**: blue "C" bracket with pale-blue interior sized like the player. Entering it finishes the level.
- **Gates** (#333333 frames): block normal walking, but pulses pass through them.
- **Legend box** (bottom-left, 3x3 grid of 2x2-cell blocks): shows the required pad pattern in the
  level's "spell colour" (L1 purple, L2 yellow, L3 pink).
- **Click pad** (bottom-centre, 3x3 grid of 3x3-cell blocks at cols 24-26/29-31/34-36,
  rows 49-51/54-56/59-61; click centres x=204/244/284, y=404/444/484):
  ALL nine cells are clickable regardless of colour. Click toggles a cell green.
  When the selected SET exactly equals the legend pattern, the spell fires and the pad clears.
- **Coloured world objects** match the spell colour and are what the spell targets.

## Spell effect
Firing sends a pulse (player-sized, player-coloured -> spell colour) from the player in the
player's FACING direction, passing through walls. If it reaches the matching coloured target,
that target activates:
 - L2 (yellow corner marks = a slot): player teleports into the slot.
 - L3 (pink lock box): lock consumed, all dark-red (#921231) locked doors disappear.
 - L1 (purple, no world target): the player itself shrank 4x4 -> 2x2 (anchored top-left).
If the pulse reaches nothing, it flies off and everything reverts (spell wasted, pad reusable).

## Actions
- ACTION1/2/3/4 = up/down/left/right: move one step = the player's own size in cells; sets facing.
  Blocked moves are no-ops.
- ACTION6 = click pad cell. Clicking off-pad flashes the pad red (no cost).
- The first action after a level starts may just play a tutorial animation and be ignored.
- No RESET/ACTION5/ACTION7 available.

## Right green strip
64-row bar filling white from the top; ~1-2 rows per action. Presumably a budget - avoid waste.

## Tactics
1. Read the legend pattern and locate the same-coloured object in the world.
2. Aim: press the arrow toward that object (this also moves the player), keeping the player
   aligned on the object's row/column.
3. Click the pad cells to match the legend pattern; the spell fires on the last click.
4. Walk to the goal. Bigger player = fewer presses per distance.

# COMPLETED GAME — full model (6 levels, won at turn 176)

## Board
512x512 px on a 64x64 grid of 8px cells. Cell (c,r) centre = (8c+4, 8r+4).

## Objects
- **Player**: blue square block, size 4x4 or 2x2 cells. Strong blue (#1E93FF) half = the leading
  edge / facing; pale (#88D8F1) = trailing. Internal facing defaults to UP at level start
  regardless of how it is drawn.
- **Floor**: gray #999999. **Gate frames**: #333333 — block walking, but spell pulses pass through.
  Black = void; pulses die there.
- **Goal**: blue "C" bracket with pale interior. Entering it (any size) finishes the level.
- **Locked doors**: solid coloured blocks (#921231 dark-red, #FF851B orange). Block walking and pulses.
- **Lock boxes**: 4x4 pink (#E53AA3) ring with a 2x2 core coloured like the doors it opens.
  Hitting it with a pink pulse deletes ALL doors of the core's colour; the box turns gray + green.
- **Teleport slots**: yellow (#FFDC00) corner dots. Dots on the slot's own corner cells + dots
  one cell diagonally outside. A slot has a fixed size (2x2 or 4x4). When the player's size
  matches AND it is the current destination, all 8 dots are shown; otherwise only 4.
  A 2x2 slot usually holds a purple 2x2 marker block when unoccupied.
- **Green 2x2**: spent/decorative marker; not steppable, safe to ignore.

## Actions
- ACTION1/2/3/4 = up/down/left/right. Move one step = the player's own size in cells
  (2x2 moves 2, 4x4 moves 4); may clamp against a wall. Blocked presses still set facing.
- ACTION6 = click a pad cell. Clicking off-pad flashes the pad red and costs nothing.
- The very first action of level 1 only plays a tutorial animation.

## The pad (bottom-centre)
3x3 grid of 3x3-cell blocks; click centres x = 204 / 244 / 284, y = 404 / 444 / 484.
ALL nine cells are always clickable; a click toggles the cell green.
When the selected SET exactly equals one of the legend patterns, that spell fires and the pad clears.

## Legend boxes (left/bottom-left), one per available spell
- PURPLE plus {(0,1),(1,0),(1,2),(2,1)} = **resize toggle** on the player.
  Shrink 4x4 -> 2x2 anchors TOP-LEFT. Grow 2x2 -> 4x4 keeps the 2x2 at the top-right / an edge and
  expands into whatever adjacent 4x4 area is legal — verify the result before planning.
- YELLOW {(0,0),(0,1),(1,1)} = **teleport** (instant, no direction) into the yellow slot whose size
  matches the player. With two slots of that size it alternates: it sends you to the one you are
  not currently occupying (watch which slot shows all 8 dots).
- PINK {(0,1),(1,1),(2,1)} = **directional pulse** from the player, player-sized, in the player's
  facing direction. Travels only over floor and gate tiles; dies on void or a locked door.
  It must line up with a pink lock box (4x4 player -> the 4x4 box; 2x2 player -> the 2x2 core).
  Click order does NOT set the direction; the last arrow pressed does.

## Right green strip
64-row budget bar filling white from the top, ~1-2 rows per action, reset each level.
Invalid/no-op actions appear free. It never ran out, but keep routes short.

## Winning routine per level
1. Read legends -> which spells exist; find same-coloured objects in the world.
2. Work out which lock boxes must be hit, and from where (row/column alignment + a floor path
   for the pulse). Locked doors block pulses, so unlock in dependency order.
3. Use purple to match the size needed for narrow gaps, teleport slots and lock cores.
4. Aim by pressing the arrow toward the target (this also moves you), then cast pink.
5. Teleport/walk to the goal; travel while 4x4 when possible (4 cells per press).

[After action · message]
**Game complete — WIN, 6/6 levels, 176 game actions.**

Final summary of what the game turned out to be:

- **Player**: a blue block (4×4 or 2×2 cells) that moves one step equal to its own size; the strong-blue half shows facing.
- **Pad** (bottom centre): a 3×3 click grid. Selecting exactly the cell-set shown by one of the **legend boxes** casts that spell:
  - **Purple plus** → toggle player size (4×4 ↔ 2×2), needed for narrow gaps and to match slot/lock sizes.
  - **Yellow** → instant teleport into the yellow-marked slot matching the player's size (alternating between two same-size slots).
  - **Pink** → a player-sized pulse fired in the facing direction; it travels over floor and gate tiles and, if aligned with a pink lock box, deletes every locked door of the core's colour.
- **Goal**: walk into the blue "C" bracket.

The key breakthroughs during play were: (1) any pad cell is clickable, and the pattern must match the legend exactly; (2) the pulse direction comes from the last arrow pressed, not click order; (3) pulses die over void, so you must fire from inside a corridor aligned with the target; and (4) locked doors block pulses, forcing a dependency order on which lock to open first.
